title: Exception Basics: try, throw and catch
learningObjectives: Explain the main rules of exception control flow.
Identify the key C++ constructs used for exception control flow.
Apply exception control flow in a small program.
Recognize common failure cases and safety concerns.
Test a practical scenario and justify the chosen approach.

understand.concept: try marks a region where exceptions may be handled. throw raises an exception. catch handles a matching type; if no local handler matches, propagation moves to the caller and local objects are destroyed during stack unwinding.
understand.whyItMatters: Exceptions allow a function to report failure to a layer capable of responding, while RAII cleans local resources.
